## Fix
1. Fixed an issue where witch's loottable would be propagated to its subclass

## Change
1. Migrate to mojmap, see [Removing Obfuscation from Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/2025/10/31/obfuscation.html)

## Change
1. FabricLoader requires `>=0.17.2`
2. MixinExtras is no longer bundled internally, as it is now natively included in the latest FabricLoader
3. Removed the `cca$` prefix from certain methods, which are now intelligently handled by the latest Mixin

### v1.11.1

1. Migrate to a new template
2. Update dependencies
3. Easter eggs are now off by default
4. Use AW to access private classes

### v1.11.2

1. Fixed the incompatibility between the rule `ItemShadowing` and the mod `carpet-shadow` #17

### v1.11.4-beta

1. Support 1.21.5

**Known issues**:  You are currently unable to create CCE using the rule `MagicBox`. this glitch is likely to be long-lasting, and I don't have a clue how to fix it at the moment (CCE you created in old Minecraft will still work)

1. Support mc1.21.4

## Change
1. mc1.19.4 has reached the end of support, See [EOL](https://crystal0404.github.io/cca-doc/en/eol/) for details
2. Remove rule `CCANetworkProtocol`
3. Change the description of some rules
4. These mods([AntiShadowPatch](https://github.com/ForwarD-NerN/AntiShadowPatch), [Carpet-Fixes](https://github.com/FxMorin/carpet-fixes), [Carpet-Shadow](https://github.com/mattymatty97/carpet-shadow)) are not compatible with the rule `ItemShadowing`, rule `ItemShadowing` is automatically disabled
